events.title: Attack UKMTO #216 21 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 216-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 21 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 0550UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 17NM east of Khasab, Oman. A Tanker transiting outbound in the Strait of Hormuz has been hit in the engine room by an unknown projectile. There are no reported casualties at this time. Environmental impact is currently unconfirmed. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #214 20 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 214-26 - ATTACK Incident Date: 20 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 1500UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 8NM north of Khasab, Oman. Suspicious Activity UKMTO #213 20 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 213-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY Incident Date: 20 Nov 2026 Incident Time: 1102UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 95NM southwest of Al Mukalla, Yemen. A Bulk Carrier travelling eastbound in the IRTC was approached on the port side by a dark blue skiff with 6 unidentified, armed persons on board. Four shots were fired in quick succession from the skiff and warning shots were returned by the armed security team onboard the Bulk Carrier. The skiff has moved away and the Bulk Carrier is continuing its voyage. The Master has reported no damage to the vessel and no injuries to any crew members. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #212 18 November 2026 UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 6NM north of Khasab, Oman. A tanker was struck by an unknown projectile in the engine room while transiting outbound through the Strait of Hormuz. The crew are safe and accounted for. Damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at the time of this report. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #211 18 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 211-26 - UKMTO has received a time-late report of an incident 13NM north of Khasab, Oman. Local authorities report a tanker was struck by an unknown projectile within the Strait of Hormuz. A fire occurred onboard, which has since been extinguished. Search and rescue efforts are underway for a missing crew member, currently unaccounted for. Vessel damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at the time of this report. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO. Attack UKMTO #208 16 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 208-226. UKMTO has received a report of an incident 7NM north of Khasab, Oman. A third-party has reported an attack involving a tanker transiting the Strait of Hormuz, disabling the vessel and resulting in an engine room fire. The crew have been reported safe. Damage assessment, and environmental impact are unknown at the time of this report. UPDATE 001-170745Z: UKMTO has received reports from a maritime security agency that the vessel sustained a second strike, which caused a fired onboard. The crew are currently unaccounted for, and damage assessment is unknown at present. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #207 16 November 2026 UKMTO has received a report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz. The Company Security Officer of a Tanker has reported the vessel being struck by an unknown projectile whilst transiting outbound. This resulted in a fire in the engine room. No casualties have been reported and all crew have been accounted for. Damage assessment and environmental impact unknown at present. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Suspicious Activity UKMTO #206 16 November 2026 UKMTO WARNING 206-26 - SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY Incident Date: 16 Nov 26 Incident Time: 0330UTC UKMTO has received a report of an incident 430NM east of Socotra, Yemen. The Master of a tanker has reported being approached by a possible mothership and skiff in position 1202N 06147E. Four armed persons were sighted onboard the skiff, with a ladder also visible. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Attack UKMTO #205 15 November 2026 UKMTO is aware of a report by Indian Shipping Authorities of an attack on a Tanker while transiting through the Arabian Gulf eastbound prior to entering the Strait of Hormuz. The crew are accounted for and safe. Damage assessment and environmental impact are unknown at time of report. Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO.
